notes.title: Haus Of Irndrous 2.0 – The Ultimate Rebirth
notes.content: [p]The time has come! 🎉[/p][p]Haus Of Irndrous leaves Early Access and steps into its [b]definitive 2.0 release[/b]. This isn’t just an update—it’s a [b]complete rebirth of the game[/b].[/p][p]We listened to your feedback, fixed everything that didn’t work, and reshaped the entire experience. The result is a more polished, immersive, and thrilling adventure with fresh surprises awaiting you.[/p][p]🔹 [b]What’s new in version 2.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Complete redesign of mechanics and gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced atmosphere, sound, and exploration.[/p][/*][*][p]Brand-new content expanding the story and immersion.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimization for a smoother, more stable experience.[/p][/*][/list][p]Haus Of Irndrous 2.0 is our full vision: [b]dark, challenging, atmospheric, and ready to trap you inside its walls[/b].[/p][p]To everyone who supported us during Early Access—thank you. Now the true story begins.[/p][p]Are you ready to enter the house again? 🕯️[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44982536/efd52e41f5d549aa5d482b9fb3c770f865747093.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Haus Of Irndrous will cost $1.99 starting July 19th!
notes.content:
[p]Hello [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i] community,
We’re deeply thankful for the incredible support you've given to the project. Every download, every comment, and every video shared has helped bring this world to life.[/p][p]Now, after careful thought and listening to our players, we want to let you know:[/p][p]🔔 [b]Starting Saturday, July 19th, 2025, the game will be priced at $1.99 USD.[/b][/p][p]This change has a clear purpose:
➡️ [b]To fund the development of new chapters[/b]
➡️ [b]To support servers, art, music, and programming[/b]
➡️ [b]To keep the price fair and accessible to everyone[/b][/p][p]This isn’t a wall — it’s a stepping stone. [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i] was born from passion, and it keeps growing thanks to all of you.[/p][p]⚠️ [b]If you haven’t downloaded the game yet, this week is your last chance to get it for free.[/b][/p][p]Thank you for supporting indie games.
– The [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i] dev team[/p]

notes.content:
[p]Thank you for continuing to explore the dark depths of [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i]!
The new version 17.0 brings several important changes to improve stability and the overall experience. Here's what's new:[/p][p]🔧 [b]Highlights of v17.0:[/b][/p][list][*][p]General performance optimization[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual bug fixes[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy AI behavior[/p][/*][*][p]Lighting adjustments in key areas[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed collision issues and blocking zones[/p][/*][*][p]Early setup for future content expansions[/p][/*][/list][p]👀 [b]What’s Next?[/b]
This is just the beginning. More content and improvements are coming soon, fueled by your feedback and support.[/p][p]💬 We'd love to hear from you! Share your thoughts in the forums or on social media.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix (v10.0) - 08/06/2025
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone![/b]
We’re excited to announce a new update for [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i] that implements several ideas suggested by you!
This version includes improved GPS systems and in-game guidance, new missions, and other essential enhancements to enrich the gameplay experience.[/p][p]Thank you for your feedback and continued support. We remain committed to polishing every detail to deliver the best possible version of [i]Haus Of Irndrous[/i].
Enjoy the update… and keep uncovering the mysteries that await you in the Afgarn mansion.[/p][p]— [i]Yxtopia Studios[/i][/p]

notes.title: Hotfix (v8.3) - 22/09/24
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We’re excited to announce a new update for Haus Of Irndrous that addresses several translation errors in the written content of the game. This update ensures that the texts are more accurate and aligned with the original story and context, providing a clearer and more immersive narrative experience.

Thank you for your feedback and continued support. We're committed to improving the game and delivering the best possible version of Haus Of Irndrous. Enjoy the update, and keep uncovering the mysteries that await you in the Afgarn mansion!

-Yxtopia Studios.
